bookmarklet.option1Instruction: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:
bookmarklet.bookmarksBarHint: Make sure your bookmarks bar is visible (Cmd+Shift+B on Mac, Ctrl+Shift+B on Windows).
bookmarklet.option2Step1: Right-click your bookmarks bar and choose "Add Page…" or "Add Bookmark…".
bookmarklet.option2Step3: URL: Click "Copy" below, then paste into the URL field.
bookmarklet.usageStep1: Go to any NYT crossword page — <daily>Daily</daily>, <mini>Mini</mini>, or other puzzle types (must be logged in with a crossword subscription).
bookmarklet.usageStep2: Click the bookmarklet in your bookmarks bar.
bookmarklet.usageStep3: Crossword Clash opens in a new tab with the puzzle loaded.
bookmarklet.disclosureText: It runs only on your NYT crossword tab when you click it, and sends puzzle data only to your second Clash tab — no third-party servers. We believe a one-click bookmarklet acting on a page you're already viewing falls within personal-use precedent, but NYT's terms restrict automated tools that circumvent access. Use only with an active NYT subscription. If NYT objects, we'll remove this feature.
